title: Two robot teams
text: Split into two teams and take turns. One player on the team gives clues.

title: One-syllable words only
text: The clue-giver's voice chip only does one-syllable words. Their team guesses out loud.

title: BZZT!
text: The other team sees the word too. If the clue-giver slips into a longer word, they hit BZZT and the clue team loses a point.

title: Scoring
text: A card scores one point per syllable, up to 3. Beat the clock and score as many as you can.
